title: Write path: every ReaderVote is 1-5; thumbs store 5/1; /api/reader/vote accepts value 1/-1/null and stars 1-5
description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Files: `amplify/plugins/reader-steering/function/handler.py` (`typed_vote_action`, `vote_action`, `rating_action`, `react`, `TOGGLE_DIMENSIONS`, `VOTE_DIMENSION`, `MINIMUM_RATING`/`MAXIMUM_RATING`, `rating_context_for`, the reader-state path ~line 384-387 that returns `held["up"] in (1, -1)`), `amplify/plugins/reader-steering/function/handler_test.py` (or the plugin's existing test module), `features_backend/reader-subject-votes.feature`, `features_backend/reader-steering.feature`.

## Change
Every write to a ReaderVote stores an integer 1-5 on every dimension, including `up`.
- `typed_vote_action` (`{subject: {type,id}, value}`): keep accepting `1 | -1 | null`; map `1 -> 5`, `-1 -> 1` before `react`; ALSO accept `stars: 1..5` (integer, not bool) as the five-star form, exclusive with `value` (sending both is `422 invalid_vote`). Add `"stars"` to `VOTE_PAYLOAD_KEYS`. The 200 reply returns `{subject, value: <stored 1-5>, stars: <same>}` plus `thumb: "up" | "down" | null` (up when stored >= 4) so old clients that read `value` get a sensible number and new clients read `stars`.
- Legacy `vote_action` (`{subject, dimension: "up", on: true|false}`): `on: true` stores 5, `on: false` removes (unchanged). `used-it` stays a toggle that stores 1 (its only meaning is presence; it is never averaged) and is documented as such.
- The reader-state response: `votes[subject].up` returns the stored 1-5; add `thumb` the same way; no code path returns -1 anymore.
- `rating_context_for` compares the stored 1-5 value (a comment explaining a thumbs down now carries `{dimension: "up", value: 1}`).
- Refuse anything else with the existing `422 invalid_vote`/`invalid_rating` wording extended to name `stars`.
No new caps, no new tables, no new settings.

## Gherkin (features_backend/reader-subject-votes.feature; rewrite the affected scenarios, add the new ones)
  Scenario: A thumbs up is stored as five and a thumbs down as one
  Scenario: A reader rates a subject with stars from one to five
  Scenario: A vote must be up, down, one to five stars, or removed
  Scenario: Sending both value and stars is refused
  Scenario: The reader state returns the stored one-to-five value and the thumb it means
  Scenario: A comment's rating context names the stored one-to-five value

## Acceptance
`poetry run pytest amplify/plugins/reader-steering` and the backend cucumber suite pass; `grep -rn "in (1, -1)" amplify/plugins/reader-steering/function/handler.py` returns nothing. PR to develop; merge is deploy (the function deploys with the next site build that pins the release).
